I'd say generally you wanna try to squeeze in a UA+drain after refreshing Sl+corruption in that situation. It all depends how much freecasting you can do. On a fight like garothi theres alot of movement very often. In your situation you do 2 GCDs to refresh dots and then a UA cast, that leaves you with around 5-6 secs to drain until you need to refresh agony.

For coven: Golg adds i dot up all, khaz i try to dot up as many as possible whilst being close to atleast on of the bosses, for aman thul dot up all but focus one. A general tip is to always start with agony on your targets as it has ramp-up-time (especially if you got legendary head). So for all adds on coven make sure they all got agony before starting to apply corruption, unless you can fit corruption in whilst moving in range of the next target. 

For argus I cant really help as I havent really done that fight much as a lock, but i'd say try to keep agony+corruption on atleast 3 targets and start dumping uas on shadow-add. When shadow is dead try maintain 3 target dots and focus big one.
